name: Endrin
displayTitle: Meet Endrin, Founder of Roman Guides
quote: "Rome isn't just a city to me—it's my home, my heartbeat, and my greatest story to share."
bio: Founder of Roman Guides. Passionate about Ancient Rome and creating experiences that feel personal, never scripted. Loves telling the untold side of Roman history, with humour, food and a good drink.

name: Alex
quote: "Every tour should feel like exploring Rome with a local friend."
bio: Archaeologist and storyteller. Turns the Colosseum into a place full of people, not just stones.

name: Luca
displayTitle: Meet Luca, Your Local City Explorer
quote: "I love bringing ancient history to life for every guest."
bio: Relaxed city explorer. Knows every shortcut, viewpoint and hidden corner of Rome.
